name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step on and hold the rails lightly for balance only, not to bear your weight.
Stand tall with a neutral spine; do not lean forward or hunch over the console.
Drive through your whole foot, favoring the heel to bias your glutes and hamstrings over your quads.
Take full steps at a steady, sustainable cadence rather than short, partial steps.
Keep your core braced to resist rotating your torso with each step.
Slow the pace gradually before stepping off rather than stopping abruptly.
